Dear Helium D. Team,

I am writing to you once again regarding my cancellation and refund request
for order Shop····, placed on October 2, 2026.

Since I have tried contacting you repeatedly without receiving any response
or acknowledgment, this is my final attempt to resolve this matter directly
with you.

Please be advised that if I do not receive a prompt reply and confirmation
of my full refund ($329.00 USD) within the next 24 hours, I will
immediately escalate this case to PayPal. I have compiled all my unanswered
emails and communication logs, and I will submit them to PayPal to initiate
a formal dispute and force a resolution on my behalf.

I expect an immediate confirmation of the cancellation and the full refund
to my original payment method.

Sincerely,

Aikaterini S.
Handed to the team · cancellation and full refund need a supervisor; customer threatens a PayPal disp

Dear Aikaterini,

Thank you for writing, and I am sorry. Your order Shop···· was placed on October 2 and nothing has shipped, and on top of that you wrote to us and got no reply. That is our failure, not yours, and I understand why you are frustrated.

Here is where things stand right now. I have put a hold on the order on our side and at the warehouse, so nothing will be dispatched while your cancellation request is being handled. Your order is paid, at $329.00, and no part of it has left us.

A cancellation and a refund to your original payment method have to be approved by a supervisor, which is not something I can do myself. I have put your request in front of Abel and Georges with your order number and the full history. Our team is offline right now, and they pick this up tomorrow, Monday, at 10am Eastern. You will get their confirmation by email in reply to this thread, so there is nothing further you need to send.

If you would rather keep the value with us, store credit for the full amount paid is available immediately and can go towards anything we have in stock, and I can also swap the order to a different unit. Just say the word and I will do it. Otherwise your cancellation request stands as it is.

Again, I am sorry for the silence until now.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support

That's great, thank you very much.

Στις Τετ 28 Οκτ 2026 στις 6:09 μ.μ., ο/η Sarah — HeliumDeploy Support <
(email hidden)> έγραψε:

Dear Aikaterini,

You are very welcome, and thank you for your patience through all of this.

Nothing more is needed from you. Your Hashcard is reserved and being prepared in Rotterdam, and the moment the label is printed the tracking number comes to you by email so you can follow it to (address hidden). If anything looks off when it lands, just reply here and I will take care of it.

It was a real pleasure to sort this out with you. If you were happy with how we handled it, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You are also very welcome in our Discord, where we post new products and where our team and other miners help with setup and tuning: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support
